description: the Lady of the Stars, a young goddess of the night sky, one strong idea: a huge thin crescent moon of glowing silver light behind her, its two horns curving up past her shoulders, close to the body, with one bright white star shining between them above her head; simple elegant armour of deep midnight indigo with silver edges, a long indigo cape lined with silver, a slim silver circlet, holding a tall silver longbow, her face lit by soft silver moonlight, a palette of only deep indigo, silver and pale gold light; young woman, clearly a woman with a feminine figure and a slim waist, very fair pale peach skin, large dark eyes with long eyelashes, long straight black hair in a high ponytail reaching down her back, a beautiful slim oval face with full lips, her face clearly visible, well lit and well drawn, with distinct eyes with dark pupils, eyebrows, nose and mouth, not in shadow; standing tall in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet, with everything around it, inside the image, the figure about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, clean readable pixel art with bold simple shapes, strong contrast and a few large details, no clutter, crisp clean outlines, mythic, overwhelming and radiant, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same design as this man, drawn as a woman: the same outfit, colours, everything around the figure and pose, but clearly a woman, with a slim feminine figure, a narrow waist and armour shaped for a woman; she keeps her own face, skin and hair as described, not his
only the face of this woman: draw her face like this, with her very fair pale skin, her dark eyes and her black hair; nothing else of this picture, not the silver tiara
